As-is shinyreact input handler (internal)

Source: R/input-handler.R
asis_input_handler.Rd

Opt-in via type = "shinyreact.asis". Returns the parsed value completely untouched (no flattening), for nested structures the default would coerce.

Usage

asis_input_handler(value, session = NULL, name = NULL)
